reason: Provides Obsidian-style wikilink mentions that search workspace notes and attach selected note contents to chat prompts, making memory and context management its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在聊天编辑器中通过 Obsidian 风格的 [[wikilink]] 搜索工作区笔记，并将选定笔记内容附加到模型提示中。
summaries.en: Adds Obsidian-style [[wikilink]] mentions to search workspace notes and attach selected note contents to model prompts from the chat composer.

capabilities: Indexes workspace note titles and paths
Fuzzy-searches workspace notes from the chat composer
Injects selected note contents into model prompts
Adds a picker and status display to the chat interface
